# iosxe_wireless_policy_tag (Resource)

This resource can manage the Wireless Policy Tag configuration. The device's built-in `default-policy-tag` cannot be deleted: destroying it only removes the attributes Terraform configured, which reverts them like the matching `no` commands (a description is cleared).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxe_wireless_policy_tag" "example" {
  tag_name    = "S2-PT-CORP"
  description = "S2 Corporate campus policy tag"
  wlan_policies = [
    {
      wlan_profile_name   = "S2-WLAN-CORP"
      policy_profile_name = "S2-PP-CORP"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag_name` (String) This object uniquely identifies the policy tag

### Optional

- `description` (String) description for the policy tag
- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `wlan_policies` (Attributes List) WLAN profile and policy profile name configuration (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--wlan_policies))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

<a id="nestedatt--wlan_policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `wlan_policies`

Required:

- `policy_profile_name` (String) Name of the policy profile
- `wlan_profile_name` (String) Name of the WLAN profile

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxe_wireless_policy_tag.example "<tag_name>"
```
